thread:
Asha: Huge thanks to Marco + Faye for jumping on the accessibility bug this morning. the customer flagged high-contrast break and you two turned it around before lunch. truly lifesavers :raised_hands:
Marco: Was a tight one. Faye spotted the CSS cascade issue and I patched the SVG contrast. quick deploy and the screenshot diff looked clean. :sparkles:
Faye: big shout to Riley for testing with the screenreader combo and verifying keyboard nav. can't stress how useful that feedback was. :heart:
Riley: happy to help. filed a tiny regression test in #qa -> 'a11y/high-contrast.spec' and added the command to CI.
Asha: sending stickers + a $75 meal voucher each. putting a kudos card on the wall under "tiny wins". :sticker: :plate_with_cutlery:
OpsBot: voucher codes DM'd to Marco and Faye. Kudos logged (2) for Marco, (2) for Faye, (1) for Riley. (automated)
Marco: also thanks to Product for the clear reproduction steps. that saved a ton of time.
Faye: added a 1-line dev note to the component: `use color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg) 80%, #000 20%) for contrast fallback` and linked it in the PR.
Riley: uploaded quick demo: https://files.redwood/screens/a11y-before-after.gif (screenreader + high-contrast toggle)
Asha: will highlight in the weekly roundup and nominate them for the monthly "Care & Ship" award. :trophy:
Marco: appreciated. small fixes like this keep customers trusting us.
Faye: thanks all. snacks meeting when the vouchers arrive? :pretzel:
Asha: yes please. pretzels on me. :pretzel:
